stories.title: Missing hiker dies in fall from Humboldt Peak
stories.summary: The body of an overdue hiker was found on the north side of the peak just before 1 p.m. Tuesday, according to Custer County Search and Rescue.

stories.title: Colorado SNAP enrollment drops amid new eligibility hurdles
stories.summary: SNAP participation in Colorado dropped 5% from July 2025 to June 2026 due to eligibility changes, leaving 34,000 without federal food aid.

stories.title: Aurora is spending $23 million to buy 2 farms 170 miles away because the city wants the water
stories.summary: Aurora said the families will keep farming under a lease. A water district in the Arkansas Valley said questions remain about who controls the water.

stories.title: Thousands of Thanksgiving meals handed out in Denver as Rescue Mission sees record requests for help
stories.summary: Denver Rescue Mission, facing unprecedented demand, distributed over 3,500 Thanksgiving meals at a drive-thru event.

stories.title: Man has trapped and egged Waymo vehicles more than 30 times in Denver, police report says
stories.summary: The man stops his vehicle in front of the Waymo, traps the vehicle with cones, throws eggs at it, then leaves it trapped, a Denver Police Department report says.

stories.title: Prep Rally Honor Roll (11/24/26) | VOTE NOW
stories.summary: Watch the best Colorado high school sports moments of the week and vote for your favorite in the 9NEWS Prep Rally Honor Roll.

stories.title: myColorado app remains offline, as state leaves questions about delay in notifying the public unanswered
stories.summary: The state has not said what data was accessed in the myColorado incident, and the app has no estimated return date as Thanksgiving travel ramps up.

stories.title: Denver mild dry Thanksgiving ahead of weekend storm and mountain snow
stories.summary: Sunshine and 50s for the rest of the week with minimal holiday travel impacts across the state until next weekend and the arrival of the next mountain storm

stories.title: CSU researchers trying to stop tiny pest wreaking havoc on Colorado's wheat fields
stories.summary: A destructive insect has cut Colorado wheat production, costing growers an estimated $70 million annually as CSU researchers work to stop the damage.

stories.title: Denver street reopens after 2 water main breaks
stories.summary: South Holly Street was closed between East Evans and East Iliff avenues since Sunday as Denver Water repaired a 69-year-old water main.

stories.title: Death in Adams County being investigated as homicide
stories.summary: The victim was found on unresponsive last week and deputies were still at the home Tuesday continuing their investigation.

stories.title: RTD launches webpage detailing Sundance Film Festival transit services
stories.summary: The Regional Transportation District previously announced expanded services for the festival taking place in Boulder from Jan. 21 to Jan. 31.
